description: List the photo sessions recorded on this operator's booths, with totals. Call this when the operator asks how busy a booth has been, how many sessions ran in a period, or wants to inspect individual sessions. Supports date ranges, per-booth filtering, payment status and payment channel. For money totals rather than session counts, use get_revenue_summary instead.

endDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the end of the range, inclusive

limit.description: How many sessions to return (default 20, max 100)

paymentSource.description: Payment channel, e.g. gateway, cash-voucher, discount-voucher

projectIds.description: Comma-separated project ids to limit the range to specific booths

startDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the start of the range, inclusive

transactionStatus.description: Payment status filter, e.g. settlement, pending

name: get_sessions

returned.description: How many are in this response

total.description: Sessions matching the filter, across all pages

title: Get photo sessions
